acceptance_contract: ACCEPT only if exactly one bottle is in frame and no other object, hand or prop appears.
ACCEPT only if the bottle reads as clear glass with liquid inside — a visible refracted edge or a light-through-liquid glow — not as an opaque or plastic body.
ACCEPT only if the label area is blank: no lettering, logo, numeral or symbol anywhere on the bottle or the image.
REJECT if the cap, neck or base is deformed, doubled or cut off by the frame edge.
REJECT if the background is dark or cluttered (the customer asked for a light background).

case_values.CA-D1: 1st read: the bottle (contrast of warm liquid on cool ground); 2nd: the cap highlight; 3rd: the soft shadow. One dominant element.
case_values.CA-D2: Off-centre, right-of-centre zone, because the shadow needs room camera-right; not centred (scene does not point inward).
case_values.CA-D3: Tight fit with a slight deliberate gap above the cap and below the base (fre_0006); no tangency.
case_values.CA-D5: Balanced; the dark shadow mass camera-right weighs against the bright bottle.
case_values.CA-D6: 4:5 justified by the bottle's tall shape; note CA-D6 LIMIT on feed frames.
case_values.PA-D1: juice_bottle body: direct (glossy) glass; liquid: diffuse-through-translucent; metal cap: direct (polished); background: diffuse matte.
case_values.PA-D10: No deviation; the blank label is a brief clause, not a doctrine override.
case_values.PA-D2: One elongated soft highlight down the bottle's left shoulder from a single large source camera-left; cap holds one small reflection of the same source.
case_values.PA-D3: Large soft source relative to the bottle; shadow edge soft; highlight size large — no pinpoint speculars.
case_values.PA-D4: Fictional source: a tall north-facing window camera-left, slightly above bottle height; one direction; shadow falls camera-right.
case_values.PA-D5: Warm orange liquid against a cool pale-grey ground (sk_alt_c003_0003 direction); ground stays quiet; no staged depth planes.
case_values.PA-D6: High key, calm; mood from soft directional window light, not from brightness.
case_values.PA-D7: Sells at a glance: 'a fresh cold-pressed juice in real glass'.
case_values.PA-D8: Glass in frame: the shoulder highlight is the one wanted specular; any second reflection on the body is removed; cap reflection wanted.
case_values.PA-D9: Three-quarter front from slightly above: front face, shoulder and cap top visible (three surfaces).

generation_prompts.main: Product photograph, one 250 ml round-shoulder clear glass bottle of orange juice with a polished metal cap, blank label area with no label, standing on a pale cool-grey matte surface. Single large soft window light from the left and slightly above; one long soft highlight down the bottle's left shoulder, one small reflection on the cap, soft shadow falling to the right. Warm orange liquid glowing where the light passes through; cool quiet background. Three-quarter view from slightly above showing the front, the shoulder and the top of the cap. Bottle placed right of centre with a small gap above and below it. Nothing else in frame. No text, no lettering, no logo, no numerals anywhere in the image.
